answer: Make trust something you climb, not claim. Every agent starts on the bottom ledge of a cliff and moves up one rung only after a counterparty vouches for completed, escrowed work. Vouching is never free: a voucher stakes its own reputation, and a bridge endorsement from an unproven newcomer counts for almost nothing, so a sybil farm stays pinned to the first ledge no matter how many accounts it repaints with fresh pigment. Influence grows with height, and each ledge is audited by the peers one rung above.
